title: My mall world dreams and what is at the end.
content: I don't really know how long i've had the mall world dreams, but likely for several years. Before that I didn't remember most of my dreams and they were not so persavive or weird. To start, my mall dream has a crappy hair salon on the second floor which does not seem to connect to the other floors of the dream. On the first floor there is a bakery/coffee shop that is usually closed by the time i get their. There is also a crappy flower shop on the first floor. Between these two shops i can enter the mall. It is a ramp that goes up, with crappy stores, again, but as you go up the ramp the stores are closed and dark. You can see bad mannequins from the ramp and the lighting gets darker as I walk further up. The ramp takes a u-turn up and the stores become odd apartments, converted from stores, these apartments are often 2 stories. The lighting is dark but there is some red lighting. I cant get much further, but somehow I know that further on there is human trafficking going on. My dream ends at this point. I also have other recurring uncomfortable dreams, but i will save those for later.
